note: Wyoming Game & Fish Tongue River Canyon Public Access Area SW of Dayton: designated campsites for up to eight parties at the canyon mouth, 3.3 mi up County Road 92 from US-14, with fire rings and shared bear-proof food lockers. Trailers and large vehicles are limited past the campsites; the road goes on 1.5 mi to a trailhead lot. --Claude
summary: WGFD page read: designated camping for up to eight parties at the canyon entrance, outhouse, open year round, 5-day limit, fire ban in effect. Stored riverview fails: the Tongue River is a creek-sized stream hidden under riparian canopy on imagery -> downgrade lead. Phone empty -> Sheridan regional office. Pin at the canyon-mouth campsites, fine.
flags: WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE (stored riverview, not --AWH): on Esri imagery the Tongue River at the canyon mouth is not visible at all - it runs under a continuous band of cottonwood and conifer SE of County Road 92, and the stream is well under ~30 m wide (creek class, so 'riverview' is the wrong class in any case). The WGFD page says nothing of sites by the water and publishes no site photos or numbers. Recommend riverview -> not waterfront (creekview is the ceiling if a reviewer finds photos showing the stream from the pull-offs).
PHONE: empty -> (307) 672-7418 (WGFD Sheridan Regional Office, named on the area page).

FIT/ACCESS: 'Access with trailers and large vehicles is limited past this point' refers to the road beyond the campsites; the campsites themselves sit at the canyon entrance on a graded gravel county road (pull-offs and a gravel turnaround visible on imagery at about 44.8500,-107.3045). No 4WD or clearance statement. Kept.
NAME: the agency's name is 'Tongue River Canyon Public Access Area' (stored 'Tongue River Dispersed Campground').
